subject: Incident synthesis & leadership OKR sync — prep for August QBR
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-support@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Incident synthesis & leadership OKR sync — prep for August QBR

Team —

Quick synthesis ahead of the QBR prep meeting: the July 22 partial degradation we had for Acme (INC-20260722) is now largely contained; infra and serving runtime mitigations reduced tail latency and restored SLA to targets, but the customer still reported user-visible errors for ~18 minutes.

High-level bullets:
- Root cause: memory pressure + degraded kernel selection for a small subset of long-sequence requests hitting a non-quantized path.
- Customer impact: saw elevated 500s and partial failures on our dedicated pool; they reported brief service interruption for their onboarding flow.
- Current status: postmortem draft attached; heatmap and SLA impact in "SLA-heatmap-Jul.pdf".

As we prepare for the August QBR I want a short, action-oriented exec summary we can present: 1 slide on incident timeline, 1 slide on customer impact and credits/commitments, 1 slide on mitigations/longer-term items mapped to OKRs.

Asks:
- Vivek: can you confirm the mitigation timeline and ownership for the kernel-selection fix? I want a one-line owner + ETA for the slide.
- Marissa: please confirm the immediate operational changes (alert thresholds, prefaulting config) that are now live and any follow-up that will touch Dedicated customers.
- Laura: I'll need a short liability/credit ask to present to Sales for Acme; please advise if legal/procurement needs to be looped.

I'll assemble a 3-slide QBR packet by EOD Friday (Aug 6). Please reply with the one-line items; if you prefer, drop text in the attached "action-items-tracker.csv".

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, acme-support@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident synthesis & leadership OKR sync — prep for August QBR

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers below and attaching the postmortem draft for review ("postmortem-draft.md").

1) One-line owner + ETA for kernel-selection fix:
   - Owner: SRE/Serving (Rishi Malhotra) — ETA: 2026-08-20 for staged rollout.

2) Mitigations already in place (live):
   - Adjusted memory prefaulting on Dedicated pools (reduce cold misses) — rolled to prod 2026-07-28.
   - Emergency routing rule to shift long-sequence traffic to fallback quantized model variant when kernel mismatch detected — live 2026-07-23.

3) Long-term work mapped to OKRs:
   - OKR-Reliability-1.2: Kernel-selection determinism improvements (Q3 milestone).
   - OKR-Performance-2.1: Expand quantized model variants for Dedicated tiers (Q4).

I flagged Rishi to confirm exact rollout plan; he'll update the postmortem.

Note on customer communication: Acme asked for a formal credit proposal. I recommend offering 25% credit for the affected window while we confirm production hardening; Sales can decide.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, acme-support@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident synthesis & leadership OKR sync — prep for August QBR

Adding operational detail for the slide deck (one-liners and amber/green status) — copying what I'll drop into the tracker.

- Alerting: Thresholds tightened for Dedicated token error rate -> LIVE (owner: Ops - Alejandro).
- Prefault config: rolled to 100% of Dedicated pools; monitoring shows 40% reduction in tail latency spikes -> VALIDATION (owner: Marissa)
- Customer routing fallback: Verified by smoke tests; fallback has 0% functional regressions in canary -> LIVE (owner: Serving QA)
- Follow-ups: schedule a runbook dry-run with CS & Ops (ETA: 2026-08-11) -> TODO (owner: Marissa)

I've attached the SLA heatmap and placed these items in action-items-tracker.csv. If Sales needs language for credit offers, let me know and I can add recommended wording.

Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-support@acme.com, jane.doe@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-05T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident synthesis & leadership OKR sync — prep for August QBR

Thanks team — clear and actionable. I will:
1) Draft a one-paragraph customer-facing status + credit proposal (25% as suggested) and run it by Legal/RevOps by Tuesday (2026-08-10).
2) Prepare a single-slide "what we did / ownership / next steps" for the exec QBR.
3) Confirm if Sales wants to propose a longer-term SLA addendum for Dedicated customers — I'll flag for the commercial review.

Agenda note for the QBR packet: please keep the incident narrative to a single timeline line (max 3 bullets) and prioritize the mitigations + OKR mapping. I will push the assembled packet to the shared drive and send a link by COB Aug 6.

Laura Bennett
SVP, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
